components.minecraft:lore: [{color:"#6BEED1",italic:0b,text:"Combines several Slimefun processing stages in one machine."},{color:"#B1C6D0",italic:0b,text:"Converts supported raw materials into metal dust."},{color:"#A774A2",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 52.0 J/s"},{color:"#FF32CE",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 1314 J capacity"}]

[{color:"#6BEED1",italic:0b,text:"Uses electricity and bone meal to produce special soil variants."},{color:"#B1C6D0",italic:0b,text:"Supports appropriate soil recipes, including netherrack."},{color:"#A774A2",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 52.0 J/s"},{color:"#FF32CE",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 1314 J capacity"}]
[{color:"#6BEED1",italic:0b,text:"Extracts light resources from luminous blocks."},{color:"#BFBAD0",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 52.0 J/s"},{color:"#FF32CE",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 1314 J capacity"}]

[{color:"#6BEED1",italic:0b,text:"Uses electricity to convert collected light into energy materials."},{color:"#BFBAD0",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 52.0 J/s"},{color:"#FF32CE",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 1314 J capacity"}]

[{color:"#6BEED1",italic:0b,text:"Ancient magic draws timber from the void."},{color:"#AACDD0",italic:0b,text:"Automatically produces logs and leaves."},{color:"#BFBAD0",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚙ 4 s"},{color:"#9C528B",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 520 J/s"},{color:"#FF32CE",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 1314 J capacity"}]
[{color:"#6BEED1",italic:0b,text:"One of the five elements: metal, wood, water, fire, and earth."},{color:"#FF32CE",italic:0b,text:"Wood embodies growth, renewal, and the life of ancient forests."}]

[{color:"#6BEED1",italic:0b,text:"Extracts the five elemental resources from the current chunk."},{color:"#AACDD0",italic:0b,text:"Run a GEO Scan before operating."},{color:"#BFBAD0",italic:0b,text:"Mining speed: 1x."},{color:"#9C528B",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 520 J/s"},{color:"#FF32CE",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 1314 J capacity"}]
[{color:"#6BEED1",italic:0b,text:"The five purified elements united in a single material."}]

[{color:"#6BEED1",italic:0b,text:"Insert a fishing rod and compatible bait to begin fishing."},{color:"#B1C6D0",italic:0b,text:"Consumes electricity and bait without wearing out the rod."},{color:"#A774A2",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 52.0 J/s"},{color:"#FF32CE",italic:0b,text:"⇨ ⚡ 1314 J capacity"}]
[{color:"#6BEED1",italic:0b,text:"Displays total Slimefun tick time and the current chunk's time."},{color:"#FF32CE",italic:0b,text:"Use it to locate demanding machine setups."}]
[{color:"#6BEED1",italic:0b,text:"One of the five elements: metal, wood, water, fire, and earth."},{color:"#FF32CE",italic:0b,text:"Metal embodies strength, order, and the bones of the mountains."}]
